name: IP2Location
tagline: IP geolocation and threat intelligence lookup API
description: IP2Location provides IP geolocation and related data via REST endpoints. Developers look up IP addresses to get country, region, city, coordinates, ISP, timezone, and optional threat/proxy fields. The public cloud API is typically accessed at api.ip2location.io with an API key; local database and other product lines also exist under the same brand.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key= (or header if documented); self-serve signup at ip2location.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: Registered Free plan: 50K IP Geolocation API queries/month, 11 IP attributes, attribution required. Keyless (no API key): 1,000 queries/day with attribution.
pricing.paid_plans: Starter $49/mo (150K geo queries); Plus $249/mo (300K); Security $499/mo (600K). Paid plans do not require attribution; overage available on commercial tiers.

rate_limits: Keyless: 1,000 queries/day (resets 00:00 UTC). Registered Free: 50,000 queries/month. No separate public per-second/RPS ceiling found on official pricing/docs.
use_cases: geolocate a visitor IP to country/city
enrich logs with ISP and ASN for an IP
detect proxy/VPN flags for fraud checks
resolve timezone offset from client IP
